appearances.demeanor: Competent, deadly efficient, sympathetic toward Perrin, uncertain when discussing factions within Tar Valon, grimly philosophical about the end times

appearances.demeanor: Commanding, firm with Lan, cryptic, worried about the Pattern and what Perrin's changes mean, focused on reaching Caemlyn

relationships.description: Moiraine holds the Warder bond with Lan. She invokes his oaths when he wants to return for Nynaeve.
Elyas was Lan's teacher, instructing him about the Blight and sword work when Elyas was a Warder.
Byar is convinced Perrin is a Darkfriend and goes out of his way to hurt him because Perrin killed two Whitecloaks.
Mental/psychic bond allowing communication. Dapple can send thoughts and images to Perrin.
Elyas served as Perrin's guide and intermediary in learning to communicate with wolves.
Nynaeve mistrusts and is antagonistic toward Moiraine, though they work together.
Protective relationship; Nynaeve is concerned for Egwene's safety and treats her wounds.
Fellow captives who support each other through their ordeal with the Whitecloaks.
Byar serves under Lord Captain Bornhald's command in the Children of the Light.
